question: Is the 2026-07-29 GHC reproducible-build result (rb_drb_haskell_ghc_concurrency_20260729) backed by a captured, re-runnable harness, or only by recorded numbers?
answer: Only partially. Four measurement scripts were committed but nothing that creates the environment they run in (container, hermit staging, host-glibc closure, entrypoint); the container they named no longer exists on any host. This experiment supplies the missing capture as a single run.sh. Re-running the identical measurement through it, five of six configurations replicate exactly and the flagship one does not: hermit --strict -j8 +RTS -C0, recorded as REPRODUCIBLE (3/3 identical), measured here as NON-REPRODUCIBLE (3/3 distinct).
replication_status: NON-REPLICATION, attribution unknown (not bisected). Candidates: a Hermit regression between 32f004cd and 1fadc037; host dependence (different machine; PMU validation fails and CPUID interception unavailable here); or the original 3-run result not being robust.

hermit.branch: origin/main (clean checkout; binary reports g1fadc03779f2, no -dirty)

reverie.state: unchanged by this experiment; this is the pin recorded by hermit 1fadc037

limitations: PMU validation fails: AmdSpecLockMapShouldBeDisabled (RCB timers unreliable)
ARCH_SET_CPUID returns ENODEV: Hermit runs without CPUID interception

method.measurement_script: harness/results_csv.sh (byte-identical to the 2026-07-29 copy, so the comparison is like-for-like)
method.fingerprint: sha256 over (all .o sorted by name) + final binary, computed outside the hermit boundary from the /work bind mount

followups: Bisect hermit 32f004cd..1fadc037 against this harness to test the regression hypothesis.
Run the same harness on a host with working PMU/CPUID faulting to test the host-dependence hypothesis.
Raise runs-per-config above 3 before any future determinism claim from this harness.
